hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if echo "$f" | grep -qE '(^|/)(dist|\.nuxt|\.output|\.data|playwright-report|test-results)/|(^|/)pnpm-lock\.yaml$|(^|/)\.env(\.[^/]*)?$|(^|/)public/og-image\.png$'; then echo "Blocked: $f is generated (og-image.png is rendered from scripts/og-image.html), managed by pnpm, or an env file. Do not edit it by hand." >&2; exit 2; fi
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.(vue|ts|js|mjs|cjs)$'; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && pnpm exec eslint --fix "$f" >&2 || exit 2; fi

i=$(cat); [ "$(echo "$i" | jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false')" = true ] && exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && git status --porcelain | grep -qE '\.(vue|ts)$' || exit 0; out=$(pnpm typecheck 2>&1) || { echo "$out" | tail -40 >&2; exit 2; }
